name: Frame Window Counter
description: Analyzes every click of a .gdr2 macro and counts how many fall into 1-, 2-, 3-, 4- and 5+-frame windows.

max-shift.name: Max shift (frames)
max-shift.description: How far each click is moved earlier / later while measuring its window. Windows wider than 2 x this + 1 are capped.

horizon-margin.name: Survival margin (frames)
horizon-margin.description: A shifted click only counts as valid if the player survives until the next click plus this many frames.

shift-release.name: Shift release with press
shift-release.description: Keep the hold length of each click when it is moved. If off, only the press moves and the release stays put.

step-budget-ms.name: Work per frame (ms)
step-budget-ms.description: How long analysis may run each rendered frame. Higher = faster analysis, laggier UI.

extra-macro-folder.name: Extra macro folder
extra-macro-folder.description: Optional additional folder that is scanned for .gdr2 files (e.g. your bot's macro folder).
